definition: to measure how heavy something is
description: A weigh-in at a boxing gym with brick walls, punching bags and a ring. A young woman boxer with braided hair, in a black top, red satin shorts and hand wraps, stands barefoot on a tall metal weighing scale on a raised platform, flexing both arms. A man in a white shirt and black trousers slides the small weight along the scale's beam to measure her, then turns and bumps fists with her. A crowd of young people in winter jackets cheers behind them.

the man in the blue jacket
